purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 504 Tanta (city code 3298); city-bound registry evidence and safe anonymous parcel-geometry route.
primaryPublisher: Egyptian Ministry of Justice Real Estate Publicity and Notarization Authority; Egyptian Survey Authority
registryBasis: An Egyptian Ministry of Justice public directory booklet hosted by the Ministry of Finance lists the Tanta Real Estate Publicity office and Tanta registration mission (مأمورية شهر طنطا); the Egyptian Survey Authority map catalogue includes a Tanta topographic sheet. These establish local registry/survey institutions, but no public cadastral parcel-vector source was verified.

officialSources.observation: Government directory booklet lists Tanta real-estate publicity office and Tanta registration mission in Western Governorate.
Official ESA topographic map catalogue/index includes Tanta sheet 88/60, a topographic product rather than a parcel map.
Official Egyptian Survey Authority site, the national survey/mapping body; used for institutional context only.
